info.title: ADSMCP REST API
info.description: ADSMCP REST API: every public ADSMCP tool as POST /api/v1/tools/{name}/execute. Generated from the ADSMCP code (the service serves the same document at GET /api/v1/openapi.json). Changes to ad accounts are staged for approval by a person on the ADSMCP dashboard; nothing in this API can approve them.

post.summary: Create a scheduled brief, stored per user and run by ADSMCP even when you are offline: daily / weekly (Monday) / monthly / every_n_days at `time` (HH:MM) in `timezone`. For Google Ads it runs the four analyses (negative-keyword candidates, anomaly drill-down, budget-allocation plan, ad-copy brief) and stores a digest that get_latest_digest returns. The digest is written by your own AI key from Settings → AI Providers, or sent data-only with a prompt to paste into your AI client. Email goes to `delivery_destination` / `recipients` (max 10). Arguments: name, schedule_type (or cadence), time, timezone, delivery_method (email | dashboard), delivery_destination, platforms (or platform_scope), account_scope (Google customer ids), jobs (negatives, anomaly, budget, ad_copy), interval_days, options { anomaly_metric, ad_copy_campaign_id, draft_approvals }.

post.summary: Hook-rate fatigue signal per ad. Reads get_tiktok_creative_analysis for a recent window and the window right before it (window_days each, ending end_date), and compares each ad's hook rate (2-second video views / impressions, derived by that tool).
